newsitem.title: USA: Crossman Q2 home sale closings increase.
newsitem.headline: Crossman Q2 home sale closings increase.

text.p: Crossmann Communities Inc, upon reporting higher second-quarter revenues and earnings, said it closed 613 home sales on the quarter versus 411 in the second quarter of 1996.

On June 30, Crossmann had a sales backlog of 1,638 homes with a sales value of about $177.8 million, compared to 1,481 homes with a sales value of about $158 million a year earlier, said the homebuilder.
"New orders for the period were up over the same quarter last year, 640 in 1997 compared to 580 in 1996," it said.
Crossmann said it completed its acquisition of Cutter Homes Ltd, a homebuilding company in Lexington, K.y
Crossman's second-quarter net income was $3.7 million on sales of $69.5 million, compared to net income of $2.6 million on sales of $45.2 million a year ago, it said.
Crossman shares closed Tuesday up 1-5/8 at 25-3/8 in over-the-counter trading.
